semantic_order: tackle contact (the foul) -> free-kick award -> set-piece placement -> served free kick

frames.label: tackle-contact
frames.description: Tackle contact (the foul): the defending body commits a man-not-ball standing tackle on the carrier — both in contact, the ball still in play (PLAYING) before the free kick is awarded

frames.label: freekick-award
frames.description: Free kick awarded: the phase turns FREE KICK after the man-not-ball contact; the ball is re-placed at the contact position and the set piece is arranged (awarded to team-b)

frames.label: freekick-placement
frames.description: Set-piece placement: the taker on the re-placed ball at the contact spot, the fouled-team receivers spread, the opposing team marking, the in-play clock frozen (FREE KICK)

frames.label: freekick-served
frames.description: Served free kick: the ball is back in play off the contact spot along the committed kick direction (player-10), the phase is PLAYING again
